input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred position: Vendor warrants professional and workmanlike performance to industry standards (19.1), material conformity of Deliverables for ninety days running from the later of delivery or acceptance and of Hosted Services throughout the subscription term (19.2, i.e. full-term coverage for the software element), plus no-malicious-code and compliance-with-law warranties (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is repair/replace/re-performance with a termination and refund backstop, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims — better than the model language, which leaves the remedy at Vendor's option. The only disclaimer (19.5) is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly carves out express warranties, service levels, indemnities and other remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Acceptance (6.1–6.2) and performance (3.1) do not shorten or condition the warranty; acceptance gives an additional correction-and-refund right and the warranty period runs from the later of delivery or acceptance. No redline needed.
